summary: Russian commonly has a zero copula in present nominal/adjectival predication; быть appears in past/future and есть is important in existence/presence.

semantic_map.SEM.IDENTITY_EQUIVALENCE: present zero copula; быть in past/future; есть only in marked/equative contexts
semantic_map.SEM.CLASSIFICATION_ROLE: present zero copula + class/role predicate; быть in other tenses
semantic_map.SEM.CHARACTERISTIC_PROPERTY: present zero copula + adjective/property predicate; быть in other tenses
semantic_map.SEM.CURRENT_STATE: present zero copula / быть + state predicate by tense
semantic_map.SEM.RESULTANT_STATE: быть + result-state predicate or lexical result construction
semantic_map.SEM.ENTITY_LOCATION: present zero/locative predicate; быть/находиться by tense/register
semantic_map.SEM.EXISTENCE_PRESENCE: есть / существует according to presentational vs lexical existence
semantic_map.SEM.TIME_DATE_PREDICATION: present nominal/zero-copula patterns; было/будет for past/future
semantic_map.SEM.POSSESSION_AS_EXISTENCE: у + possessor + есть is a core existential-style possession pattern
